_comment: Consumed by .github/workflows/red-green-gate.yml. This copy covers ONE branch — fix/security-quinn-udp, the dependency-advisory branch cut from C0 — and ships the gate extended for it (this entry, plus tests/** and Cargo.lock in the trigger paths). The five delivery branches carry their own five-entry copy of the gate and manifest; this branch does not modify theirs. Values must be shell-safe: no double quotes, backticks, dollar signs or backslashes. The gate reads exactly: branch, kind, red, green, test_path, test_target, filter, expect_red, expect_green.

branches.expect_red: is inside the range affected by RUSTSEC-2026-0538

_evidence.policy_test: a lockfile pin, not an exploit: it asserts no resolved generation of quinn-udp or quinn-proto is inside an affected advisory range, and says nothing about reachability
_evidence.multi_version: the pin iterates EVERY resolved generation, and a synthetic-lock test in the same file proves a second affected generation cannot hide behind a fixed first one
_evidence.bump: cargo update -p quinn-udp --precise 0.5.16 (cargo 1.99.0), inside quinn 0.11.9's own quinn-udp = 0.5 constraint; cargo also dropped a duplicate windows-sys 0.60.2 generation, left as generated rather than hand-trimmed
_evidence.advisories: RUSTSEC-2026-0538 (quinn-udp; fixed 0.5.16 / 0.6.3) drives the transition; RUSTSEC-2026-0524 (quinn-proto; fixed 0.11.19) is already satisfied at C0 and is pinned so it cannot regress
_evidence.red_run: the pin fails on the RED commit with quinn-udp 0.5.14 is inside the range affected by RUSTSEC-2026-0538 / GHSA-6pp4-4cxf-xf88 (fixed in 0.5.16); 2 passed, 1 failed
_evidence.green_run: 3 passed, 0 failed, and the marker policy: quinn-udp clears RUSTSEC-2026-0538 is printed under --nocapture
_evidence.fmt: cargo fmt --all -- --check is clean on the branch
